plan: In a single-round auction with rational bidders, the optimal strategy is to bid strategically based on my private value. Since my value is $22, I want to win if possible without overpaying. A bid around $20-$21 seems reasonable - high enough to potentially win, but not so high that I risk negative earnings if the second-highest bid is close to my bid.
